name: app_users.app_users_family_id_fkey
definition: FOREIGN KEY (family_id) REFERENCES families(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

name: family_invitations.family_invitations_accepted_by_user_id_fkey
definition: FOREIGN KEY (accepted_by_user_id) REFERENCES app_users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

name: family_invitations.family_invitations_created_by_user_id_fkey
definition: FOREIGN KEY (created_by_user_id) REFERENCES app_users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

name: family_invitations.family_invitations_family_id_fkey
definition: FOREIGN KEY (family_id) REFERENCES families(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

name: family_invitations.invitation_state
definition: CHECK ((((status = 'pending'::text) AND (accepted_by_user_id IS NULL) AND (accepted_at IS NULL) AND (revoked_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'accepted'::text) AND (accepted_by_user_id IS NOT NULL) AND (accepted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (revoked_at IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'revoked'::text) AND (accepted_by_user_id IS NULL) AND (accepted_at IS NULL) AND (revoked_at IS NOT NULL))))

name: menu_recipes.menu_image_bound
definition: CHECK (((image_url IS NULL) OR ((octet_length(image_url) >= 1) AND (octet_length(image_url) <= 2048) AND (image_url = TRIM(BOTH FROM image_url)))))

name: menu_recipes.menu_recipes_family_id_fkey
definition: FOREIGN KEY (family_id) REFERENCES families(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

name: menu_recipes.menu_source_bound
definition: CHECK (((octet_length(source_url) >= 1) AND (octet_length(source_url) <= 2048) AND (source_url = TRIM(BOTH FROM source_url))))

name: menu_recipes.menu_summary_bound
definition: CHECK (((length(summary) >= 1) AND (length(summary) <= 600) AND (summary = TRIM(BOTH FROM summary))))

name: menu_recipes.menu_time_pair
definition: CHECK ((((time_kind IS NULL) AND (time_text IS NULL)) OR ((time_kind IS NOT NULL) AND (time_kind = ANY (ARRAY['cook'::text, 'total'::text])) AND (time_text IS NOT NULL) AND ((length(time_text) >= 1) AND (length(time_text) <= 80)) AND (time_text = TRIM(BOTH FROM time_text)))))

name: menu_recipes.menu_title_bound
definition: CHECK (((length(title) >= 1) AND (length(title) <= 160) AND (title = TRIM(BOTH FROM title))))
